holds: Actual OS display mapping and PRINT_DEVICE-enabled writes to original 0x000b0000 are unproven. Default routing leaves mono device disabled, but an environment override can enable it.
Negative cursor tab/newline arithmetic is compared with original bytes, but printable glyph writes at a negative cursor and row indices above 24 remain outside bounded acceptance.
Original mono format buffers are 256 bytes while 005a299e gives the core a 0x7fffffff limit; malformed/overlong formats and spill are outside acceptance.
Formatter descriptor tail remains opaque/uninitialized; proof checks its initialized prefix and observed branch, not arbitrary tail contents.
